thread:
maria_support: Heads up — multiple customers reporting 5xx/gateway timeouts on Hosted API since ~15:20 UTC. Error rates jump for /v1/generate and /v1/chat. Getting 502 and 504s, timeouts from upstream cache. Correlation ids: c-id=7f9a2e, c-id=7f9a3. Anyone oncall?

yang_oncall: I'm on it. Can you paste one sample request + response body? Also which customers are impacted?

maria_support: Customer reports: acme-payments and tinyapps. Repro curl below (anonymized):

```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -d '{"model":"r-xlarge","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
> HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
> content-type: application/json
> x-request-id: c-id=7f9a2e

{
  "error": {"message": "upstream cache timeout (kv-prefix)"}
}
```

maria_support: Also seeing console errors like `cache: kv-prefix timeout=1200ms` in logs.

dmitri_eng_runtime: I'm seeing a sharp increase in prefix cache miss latency around 15:18 UTC. Redis cluster leader flapping + memcached evictions on prefix nodes. Metrics: redis_p99_cmd_latency jumped to 900ms, memcached_evictions spiked. Service health shows repeated reconnects to redis-primary-1.

dmitri_eng_runtime: stack trace from runtime logs: 
```
2026-03-17T15:19:02Z [ERROR] prefix_cache: get(key=acct:acme:ctx) err=READ_TIMEOUT backend=redis-primary-1
2026-03-17T15:19:02Z [WARN] fallback: prefix-cache miss, fallback to cold path
2026-03-17T15:19:03Z [ERROR] http: upstream error code=504 route=/v1/generate c-id=7f9a2e
```

sophie_eng_sre: Paging infra team now. @dmitri, can you confirm if the runtime is propagating upstream timeouts vs returning graceful cached fallback? We need to avoid blanket 5xx to customers.

dmitri_eng_runtime: Currently runtime waits for kv-prefetch with timeout 1.2s; if backend doesn't respond, it treats as hard failure for some fast paths (we didn't wire in fail-open for that route). That explains 504s.

sophie_eng_sre: Mitigation plan: 1) Temporarily widen the kv timeout to 2s and enable fail-open for prefix-cache reads, 2) Roll traffic to a variant that bypasses prefix caching for high-traffic customers, 3) Put autoscaling on redis-primary nodes and restart the flapping instance after draining. Any objections?

jess_csr: Can we notify affected customers with a brief explanation + ETA? Acme wants hourly updates.

sophie_eng_sre: Yes — please send advisory: short note explaining transient cache backend issues causing increased 5xx, we have mitigation steps in progress, ETA ~30-45m. Assigning follow-ups.

maria_support: I've created ticket INC-2026 and posted to #incidents. Copying suggested message to customer: "We are investigating a transient cache dependency outage causing timeouts. We're rerouting requests and expect improved success within 30–45m. We'll share updates every 30m or sooner."

yang_oncall: Implemented config change: kv timeout -> 2000ms, enabled fail-open flag for prefix-cache in canary region. Observing immediate drop in 504s in canary (acme-payments region).

dmitri_eng_runtime: Canary looks good: error rate down ~70% for that route. Starting rollout to main region with 5% steps.

deploy_bot: Deploy started: runtime-config-update v2026-03-17-kv-failopen -> canary (sha: a1b2c3).

sophie_eng_sre: Also scaling redis-primary by +2 replicas and investigating why leader flapped (network jitter suspected). Eng-infra will attach host-level metrics.

jess_csr: Customer notified. They replied: "Thanks for the quick update — please keep us posted."

maria_support: Logging follow-up: collect sample traces for c-id=7f9a2e and 7f9a3 and attach to INC-2026. Check if any billing anomalies from request retries.

yang_oncall: Will collect traces and hand to SRE. Setting priority P1 for this incident.

dmitri_eng_runtime: Post-rollout: overall 5xxs returned to baseline, redis latency back to p95=120ms. Continuing to monitor; will add stronger circuit-breaker and fallback logic in next sprint to avoid this class of outage.

sophie_eng_sre: Good job team. Keep incident open for 2h for monitoring and send postmortem once we have root cause.

maria_support: Closing customer-facing loop now. Will post updates to #support-status and the ticket. :white_check_mark:
